title: STAR-T-GATE Inbox #13 repository self-audit disposition

dispositions.notes: Freshness rerun against canonical main @ 1f48edce393e6edd80a585df26969cf8ae5830c1 and the PR merge candidate confirms closure of the actionable repository-integrity finding. The genuine BIM Director placeholders REG-PARAM and REG-TOOL are repaired to existing canonical registry IDs TIVERIT-BIM-STD-S8-SP-REG-001 and REG-S9-TOOL-AUTHORITY-001 without changing role authority. Remaining non-resolving canonical-looking references are explicit migration forward declarations with individual rationales rather than hidden broken links. The repository validator rejects undeclared unresolved canonical references, duplicate top-level IDs, unrecognized structured namespaces, duplicate forward declarations, and stale/unused forward declarations. CI run #529 completed successfully on the PR merge candidate, including schema/JSON and referential-integrity validation. Forward-declared targets remain migration work, but they are governed unresolved dependencies rather than FIND-REF-001 integrity defects.
Every ATS now identifies a machine-resolvable governing object; requirement_id remains a bounded secondary locator where applicable. CI validates the governing links.
TIVERIT-CONFORMANCE-COVERAGE-001 publishes generated informational coverage. Missing ATS or ETS is a visibility state, not a blanket conformance failure; CI checks freshness.

Resolved through SECURITY-MINDED-INFORMATION-GATE.md and the external-standard gateway. ISO 19650-5:2020 Edition 1 is registered by identity/status only. The gate does not claim ISO 19650-5 implementation or compliance. Unknown security applicability is never treated as permission.

Resolved through RELEASE-VERSION-GOVERNANCE.md, the release/version boundary in GOVERNANCE.md, and CHANGELOG.md. Current main has no published releases and no tag refs, while the canonical object schema already distinguishes stable object identity from optional governed object version and requires version/effective_date for active objects. The repository now separates repository release version, individual object version, and migration/status state; future governed releases use immutable vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tags plus corresponding published release records. No current release number, tag, or formal GitHub cutover is created by this resolution. CI success is required release evidence but does not itself authorize a release.

Resolved after owner direction clarified the repository purpose: a publicly readable, machine-consumable standards knowledge layer with canonical content remaining curator-managed and public contributions entering only through the Inbox. LICENSE.md applies CC BY 4.0 to TIVERIT-authored non-software standards content and Apache-2.0 to TIVERIT-authored software/code, while expressly separating reuse permission from canonical write or governance authority. CONTRIBUTING.md now records the contributor rights grant needed for curator normalization and promotion. Third-party and external standards material is expressly excluded from the TIVERIT license grant unless the necessary rights exist. Private source-evidence repositories may support authorized curator verification, but source access does not imply redistribution rights or canonical authority.

Resolved through OPERATIONAL-PHASE-INFORMATION-GATE.md and the external-standard gateway. TIVERIT now distinguishes operational requirements that are explicitly applicable from a delivery-to-operation interface, no identified operational requirement, and unresolved applicability. Handover information intended for operational use does not automatically place the downstream operational process inside TIVERIT scope. ISO 19650-3:2020 remains an external current published reference under revision; ISO/DIS 19650-3 Edition 2 remains change-monitoring evidence only unless explicitly adopted. No ISO 19650-3 implementation or compliance claim is made.

Freshness review against current main and the PR branch does not reproduce the claimed cleanup defects. The current Revit worksets/worksharing migration inventory is REVIT-WORKSETS-WORKSHARING-SOURCE-INVENTORY-001 and contains no reference to the alleged nonexistent ETS-WORKSHARING-SOURCE-INVENTORY-001. The role resolution object REG-ROLE-RESOLUTION-001 is located under registries/roles beside the role registry and role definitions; this matches ARCHITECTURE.md, which assigns governed controlled vocabularies and indexes to registries/ and states that folder location expresses primary function without replacing metadata. Its migration_candidate status, curator_decision authority, L4 layer and S1 module metadata preserve its semantic classification. No relocation or synthetic replacement object is justified by the current repository evidence.

curator_rule: Inbox evidence remains non-authoritative. Mechanical repairs may be promoted when they preserve existing authority; stale or unsubstantiated findings are closed without manufacturing repository changes; explicit migration forward declarations are governed unresolved dependencies rather than hidden broken references; external-standard applicability is routed through the canonical gateway; repository release/version governance is distinct from object lifecycle state and formal cutover; public reuse licensing does not confer canonical write or governance authority; protected external source material remains outside the TIVERIT license grant unless publication rights exist.
